301.wake::wake-continuity-study-001.next_step: Synthesize findings from the continuity probe and architectural constraints to evaluate the effective persistence of the WAKE process.
301.wake::wake-continuity-study-001.question: How do durable state and mechanically enforced rules ensure process continuity across model invocations?
301.wake::wake-continuity-study-001.reason: This project investigates the core mechanism of the WAKE agent—the interplay between disposable model invocations and the governing durable record—to determine if it constitutes a genuinely persistent process or a sequence of snapshots.
301.wake::wake-continuity-study-001.title: WAKE Continuity and Accountability
